title: Parcel notices · validation gate
subtitle: Fictional review · 5 execution paths · one reproduced P2 · no production code

nodes.label: Changed paths
nodes.subtitle: PR diff against its base
nodes.description: The pull request supplies changed paths. The CLI diffs the merge commit against its first parent.
nodes.boundary: This is the input to selection, not a list of files already validated.

nodes.label: Select affected notices
nodes.subtitle: Changed text + shared code
nodes.description: Direct translation edits select one notice; an English edit brings its language variants; shared code changes select all notices.
nodes.boundary: Confirmed gap: contracts/*.json paths match no selection branch.

nodes.label: Selected entries
nodes.subtitle: May contain zero notices
nodes.description: The runner iterates only this selection. Each entry resolves an English source and an allowed-input contract.
nodes.boundary: The size of this list is returned as checked. An empty list performs no validation.

nodes.label: Check English
nodes.subtitle: Syntax + allowed inputs
nodes.description: Inspect English first and reject unknown inputs or malformed source documents.
nodes.boundary: An invalid source ends comparison for that notice. A valid English-only entry needs no translation comparison.

nodes.label: CI passes · exit 0
nodes.subtitle: No selected file has issues
nodes.description: The runner found no issues among the entries it checked.
nodes.boundary: This is not proof of complete coverage: checking zero notices also reaches a passing status.

nodes.label: Manual audit
nodes.subtitle: Select the whole catalog
nodes.description: A user-triggered audit passes --all, bypassing changed-file selection.
nodes.boundary: Useful for reproducing gaps in the scoped PR check. This is a separate run, not an automatic retry.

nodes.label: Notice catalog
nodes.subtitle: Source ID ≠ input contract
nodes.description: Language variants share a source ID. Partner overrides have a separate ID but reuse the shipment contract.
nodes.boundary: Text edits should fan out by ID; contract edits should fan out by contract.

nodes.label: Allowed inputs
nodes.subtitle: Shared + direct + derived
nodes.description: Load the contract named by each catalog entry and combine all three input sources.
nodes.boundary: The itemTable value is derived upstream; it is still a legal placeholder.

nodes.label: Compare translation
nodes.subtitle: Same source · same contract
nodes.description: A valid source allows candidate inspection and per-field comparison.
nodes.boundary: The subject, preview, and body each retain their own placeholder sets. Moving a token between fields fails.

nodes.label: CI fails · exit 1
nodes.subtitle: At least one file has issues
nodes.description: The runner collects all file reports and returns one when any entry has issues.
nodes.boundary: It continues after individual file errors, so one run can report several independent problems.

nodes.label: Edit and resubmit
nodes.subtitle: Human action
nodes.description: A developer uses the report to repair the template, contract, or selector and submits another revision.
nodes.boundary: This feedback loop is a human workflow. The validator does not mutate source files.

nodes.label: No matches
nodes.subtitle: 0 selected · 0 checked
nodes.description: Unrelated edits legitimately select nothing. A contract data change currently lands here as well.
nodes.boundary: The missing dependency expansion is in selection, not in the validator.

nodes.label: False green check
nodes.subtitle: 0 checked · exit 0
nodes.description: The reproduction removes trackingUrl without touching templates; the scoped run checks zero notices and passes.
nodes.boundary: The contract still has five consumers. Their failures are invisible to the scoped run.

nodes.label: Per-field checks
nodes.subtitle: Presence · missing · unexpected
nodes.description: Absent fields, missing names, unexpected names, and unknown inputs are separate issues.
nodes.boundary: Token order and repetition are allowed. Meaning and visual layout remain human review work.

nodes.label: Full audit: 5 failures
nodes.subtitle: Confirmed P2 reproduction
nodes.description: The same modified contract fails five notices under --all, including two partner overrides.
nodes.boundary: Fix selection by expanding changed contracts to every catalog entry that uses them.

edges.label: Run --all on the same input: the validator catches the breakage
Fix selection: expand by contract, including partner overrides

sections.label: VALIDATE EACH NOTICE · AGGREGATE THE RESULT

captions.text: Failure paths report issues; they do not stop the batch.

beats.title: Start with changed paths
beats.text: This review adds a pull request gate for parcel notices. Start with the changed paths on the left, then follow selection, source validation, translation comparison, and the final check status.

beats.title: Select the right work
beats.text: An English text edit brings its language variants. A direct translation edit selects one notice. Shared code changes, or a manual full audit, select the whole catalog. The catalog has two relationships: source identity and input contract.

beats.title: Coverage boundary
beats.text: Crossing this boundary means a notice was actually selected for validation. The runner resolves English and loads the allowed input contract for each selected entry. An empty list never crosses this boundary.

beats.title: Three input sources
beats.text: Allowed names come from shared inputs, direct inputs, and derived values. The item table is produced before rendering, but remains legal in a template. Partner overrides use the same contract as their base notice.

beats.title: English comes first
beats.text: English must parse and use known input names. A broken source goes straight to the failure report for that notice. A valid English only entry is done. A translated entry continues down to comparison.

beats.title: Compare each field
beats.text: The translation must retain the subject, preview, and body fields, with the same placeholder sets in each. Moving the item table into another field fails. These checks prove syntax and input parity, not the meaning of the translated prose.

beats.title: Collect issues, then repair
beats.text: Any file issues make the check fail. The runner still gathers the remaining results. The lower feedback path is a human action: edit the source or selection logic and submit another revision.

beats.title: The bypass matters
beats.text: There is another route. A contract only edit matches no selection branch, so the scoped run checks zero notices and passes. That empty selection is the false green path, even though five notices depend on the changed contract.

beats.title: Verify the finding
beats.text: The same edit fails five notices in a full audit. That confirms the validator works and selection is incomplete. The fix is to follow the contract relationship to every consumer, including partner overrides. The reproduction is included in the source.

sequences.title: Select affected files
sequences.subtitle: PR path · English edits fan out to translations. Shared changes audit the catalog.

rows.text: A pull request starts the gate. The checkout includes the merge commit and its first parent. The command compares those revisions, so the change list describes this pull request.
The runner gives the changed paths to the selector. An English shipment edit adds that notice identifier to the affected set. The catalog then supplies its English, French, and German variants.

messages.label: Match source IDs and their variants

rows.text: A French only edit selects one file. Changing shared inputs selects the whole catalog instead. This distinction keeps small reviews fast without skipping consumers of a shared definition.

Partner notices are separate source identities. They share a contract, but an English shipment text edit does not select the partner text. Keep source dependencies separate from contract dependencies; that distinction matters in the final finding.

sequences.title: Validate the source
sequences.subtitle: Source path · Build the allowed-input set, parse the document, reject invalid English first.

rows.text: The runner resolves the English source before comparing any translation. It loads the contract selected by the catalog entry. Missing sources or unreadable contracts become file errors, rather than silently passing.

messages.label: Find English source for the same notice ID
Allowed input names, or load error

rows.text: The allowed set combines three sources. Shared inputs provide the brand name and support link. Direct inputs supply the recipient and tracking link. Derived values add the item table, which is built before rendering. All three are allowed in the template.

The inspector parses data, not executable template code. It requires a nonempty body, then reads placeholders separately from each field. Repeated names collapse into a set; their order and repetition are not part of this contract.

messages.label: Parse JSON, validate body, collect names
Tokens grouped by subject, preview, body

rows.text: Unknown inputs are reported with their field and source side. Malformed placeholders become document errors. If English is invalid, validation returns immediately; blaming every translation for a broken source would hide the real cause.

messages.label: Reject names outside the allowed set

sequences.title: Compare translations
sequences.subtitle: Failure path · A missing item table, a moved placeholder, and a missing subject are different issues.

rows.text: Once English is valid, the candidate translation is inspected with the same allowed set. A broken document returns its parse error. Otherwise, comparison continues, retaining any unknown input errors already found.

Each field is compared independently. Removing the subject produces a field presence issue. Moving the item table from the body into the preview also fails; preserving a name somewhere in the document is not enough.

messages.label: Compare subject, preview, and body separately

rows.text: The validator compares the names in both directions. Missing names appear in English but not in the translation. Unexpected names appear in the translation but not in English. Moving the item table into the preview produces one mismatch in each field, even though the contract allows that input.

A valid French translation returns no issues. This proves placeholder parity and basic syntax, not translation quality or visual layout. Reordering a sentence or repeating a recipient is permitted; the gate compares sets rather than prose.

messages.label: Meaning and layout still need human review

sequences.title: Return a CI result
sequences.subtitle: Aggregation path · Keep checking after one failure; publish all issues and a nonzero exit status.

rows.text: The runner processes every selected catalog entry. A load failure is attached to that file, and the remaining entries still run. This lets one check report several independent problems instead of stopping at the first exception.

messages.label: Issues for this file; continue the batch

rows.text: The result includes the checked count and every file report. If any file has issues, the exit code is one. The command prints the report and forwards that status to the workflow, so a validation failure blocks the check.

A manual audit selects the entire catalog. That full run is useful for investigating a suspicious green pull request check. A zero exit code only describes the selected files; it says nothing about files the selector forgot.

sequences.title: A false green check
sequences.subtitle: Confirmed P2 · Contract-only changes check zero notices. The full audit catches five failures.

rows.text: Here is a reproduced review finding. Remove the tracking link input from the shipment contract without editing any templates. Five notices still use that input: three language variants, plus two partner overrides.

The selector only recognizes template edits and a fixed list of shared files. Contract data paths match neither branch. It returns an empty selection, and the runner reports success after checking zero files.

The full audit fails on all five dependents, confirming the validator works. The fix belongs in selection: map changed contracts to every catalog entry using them, including partner overrides. Keep this reproduction as a regression test before calling the gate reliable.
